strings.title: Group Anagrams
strings.prompt: Given an array of strings, group the strings that are anagrams of each other. Return the groups in any order.
constraints: strs[i] consists of lowercase English letters

two-pointers.title: Container With Most Water
two-pointers.prompt: Given an array `height` where each element is the height of a vertical line at that x-coordinate, find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container holding the most water. Return the maximum area.

sliding-window.title: Longest Substring Without Repeats
sliding-window.prompt: Given a string `s`, find the length of the longest substring that contains no repeating characters.

stack.title: Valid Bracket Sequence
stack.prompt: Given a string containing only the characters '(){}[]', determine whether the brackets are correctly matched and nested.

linked-list.title: Reverse a Linked List
linked-list.prompt: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list in place and return the new head.
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [0, 5000]

binary-tree.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
binary-tree.prompt: Given the root of a binary tree, return its maximum depth — the number of nodes along the longest path from the root down to a leaf.
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [0, 10^4]

binary-search-tree.title: Validate a BST
binary-search-tree.prompt: Given the root of a binary tree, determine whether it is a valid binary search tree: every node's left subtree contains only smaller keys and its right subtree only larger keys.
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [1, 10^4]

trie.prompt: Design a trie supporting `insert(word)`, `search(word)` (exact match), and `starts_with(prefix)` (any word with the given prefix).
examples: insert("apple"); search("apple") -> true; search("app") -> false; starts_with("app") -> true
constraints: Words and prefixes consist of lowercase English letters

graphs.title: Number of Islands
graphs.prompt: Given an m x n grid of '1' (land) and '0' (water), count the number of islands. An island is land connected horizontally or vertically.

greedy.title: Jump Game

intervals.title: Merge Intervals
intervals.prompt: Given a list of intervals [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return the resulting non-overlapping intervals sorted by start.
